text.title: FreshDrop, company level, value chain, September 2026
text.r3: Picks and checks an order in 6 min
text.r4: Routes couriers by slot and district
text.r5: Delivers in 30–120 min, one drop at a time
text.r6: Handles refunds and complaints in chat
text.c3: Labour: 3% of revenue; 6 min per order
text.c5: Courier pay: 11% of revenue; 28 min per drop
text.c6: Support: 1.2% of revenue; 1 min per chat
text.s1: Fresh, on-time stock in the app
text.s5: Courier on the map, delivered in the slot
text.margin: order revenue 1,200 rub minus the costs of all links, 180 rub
text.value: Fresh groceries at store prices, delivered within 2 hours; app rating 4.7
text.waste: Picking mistakes and returns: 3% of orders; double handling in dark stores
text.decision: Add a barcode scan step to picking; move slow SKUs out of 2 dark stores
text.check: Error rate below 1.5% and margin 180 RUB per order by 1 December
text.sources: finance report August 2026, courier logs, supplier price lists
